dialect.detail: Logic Inc. insurance/compensation system converted by COBOL Conversion Aid PO 5785-ABJ on 02/12/96; Year 2000 reviewed; VMOD=2.008. Uses IBM-style ASSIGN clauses (SYSxxx-FBA1-...), COMP fields, DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE, GOBACK, and EJECT directives typical of IBM mainframe COBOL.

purpose.domain_detail: Insurance compensation processing — reads a Compensation Master file and creates General Agent payment/adjustment records for agents with outstanding balances.
purpose.summary: EL565 reads the ERCOMP (Compensation Master) indexed file and a control file (ELCNTL), then writes payment and adjustment records (ERPYAJ) for each General Agent or account with a negative ending balance. It is part of a larger insurance back-office compensation and payment system authored by Logic Inc. of Dallas, Texas.

notable_features: Indexed file I/O with FILE STATUS checks (ERCOMP, ELCNTL, ERPYAJ)
DYNAMIC access with START ... KEY NOT LESS THAN
Multiple COPY statements for file descriptors and date routines (ELCDTEFD, ERCCOMP, ELCCNTL, ERCPYAJ, ELCDATE, ELCDTECX, ELCDTEVR, ELCDTERX)
ACCEPT ... FROM TIME for timestamp generation
DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE for error messaging
Year 2000 compliance review noted in comments
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (~204 of 367 lines). All four COBOL divisions are present. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown. The program appears to be a converted (from an older dialect) IBM mainframe batch program for an insurance compensation system.
